reponse: Yes, a new one is needed. As a service provider, Quillon must test segmentation at least every six months and after any segmentation change; the March 2026 Redline test covers the first half only, and a second test for H2 is required before fieldwork starts on Dec 8 [2]. The tracker left 11.4.5/11.4.6 Open because the March test is the only segmentation test on file [1]. The H2 test is booked with Redline for Nov 30 – Dec 2, report promised Dec 4 [3][4]. The signed SOW only covers the March test, so extra testing is quoted separately [5].
